passages.name: NORTH HOENN STRAIT
passages.definition: Canal entre o litoral de Kanto e o norte da Rota 124, em Hoenn.

passages.name: TWO-THREE PASSAGE

passages.name: TANOBY DAWN SEA
passages.definition: Mar ao sul de Sevii que une Tanoby, o mar de Seven Island e a costa de Birth Island.
